stepHeader.scenarioQuote: The meeting room AC isn't cooling, needs a repair report.
descriptions: Scan the QR code attached to the asset to pull up its record instantly — no manual lookup needed.
Review the asset's details and maintenance history before deciding what to do next.
Select the issue type and fill in the details — the system will automatically create a work order for the right team to act on.
Assign the work order to the right team or person and set a due date so nothing falls through the cracks.
Update the work order as the team resolves the issue, attach after-repair photos, and close it out.
Review the asset's full maintenance history and the reports generated along the way.

step1.phoneDescription: Point your camera at the QR code on the asset label.
step1.cardDescription: Every ThunderOne asset carries a QR code. Scanning it opens the asset's record instantly, so field staff never have to search for it manually.

step2.phoneDescription: Read-only view of the scanned asset's record.
step2.cardDescription: See everything about this asset in one place — location, category, age, value, and its full maintenance history — before deciding what action to take.

form.title: Report Issue
form.detailsPlaceholder: AC turns on but doesn't cool
form.infoNote: The system will automatically create a work order once submitted, and notify the relevant team.
form.successDescription: The work order has been created and relevant parties have been notified.

step4.phoneDescription: Assign this work order to the right team.
step4.cardDescription: Route the work order to the team or technician responsible for HVAC systems, and set a due date so the request doesn't stall.

step5.phoneDescription: Update progress and close the work order once resolved.
step5.cardDescription: The assigned technician updates status as they work, attaches after-repair photos, and closes the work order once the AC is cooling again.

step6.phoneDescription: Every past work order and inspection for this asset.
step6.cardDescription: Review everything that's happened to this asset over time, and generate reports for planning and compliance.
